comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Fifth Private Farm: Unalaska Island
Located in the Eastern Bering Sea (8695,2401), and only accessible by unlocking the Northeast Passage through Mercator's World Atlas quest, I believe. Stats can be found here: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Privatefarm

Screenshots, including a map showing its exact location, here: ransumo.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-220.html?sp

I've personally nicknamed it "Alchemist's Paradise", due to the fact that it can produce Mandrake, Sulphur, Silver and Cinnabar, among other goods. But for East Asian servers at least, this wasn't available until Atlantis 3.5 "Americas" patch, and should not be out at the time of this posting.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Regarding the pepper problem... I'm far from a fan of Papaya, but they're innocent of this particular crime. If you consult the table of farm trade goods found here:

gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Privatefarm

When translated, it shows Unalaska gives "pepper". But revert that table back to the original Japanese language, and we get 唐辛子 -- which, when we put it through the UWO DB's Japanese search engine, gives us the page for Chillies (as the game calls it). No substitutions were made in this case.
